question: Does the pinned realFluidReactingFoam build run at all on a correctly configured case, and what is the smallest defensible set of case changes required to exercise its intended equations?
conclusion: Two per-species div-scheme entries in fvSchemes are sufficient. The target solver then integrates 200 time steps to the requested endTime with the Peng-Robinson property path and a normal End. The gap was configuration, not unsupported physics and not an implementation defect.

environment.note: The container cannot run the host-built solver (libmpi.so.40 absent), so both arms executed on the host under the profile env file, as in cfd-job-001.

armA-as-shipped.change: none; the case as shipped, which specifies application reactingFoam
armA-as-shipped.outcome: FOAM FATAL IO ERROR: keyword div(((hei_O2*rho)*YVi_O2)) is undefined in .../system/fvSchemes/divSchemes

armB-with-species-schemes.change: two lines added to divSchemes, see changes/fvSchemes.diff
armB-with-species-schemes.outcome: normal End; 200 time steps; last reported time 0.002 equals the requested endTime

comparison.baseline: the package's own reactingFoam build on the same case, cfd-job-001
comparison.note: First-and-last sampled values, not a time history. The 0.06 K difference at max T is in the direction and rough magnitude expected of the extra species-diffusion enthalpy flux terms that realFluidReactingFoam carries and reactingFoam does not; it is not here established to be that term, only that the two solvers do not diverge over 200 steps.

hypotheses.H1_configuration_gap: supported — adding the two entries was sufficient
hypotheses.H2_needs_more_case_structure: not supported — no further case change was required
hypotheses.implementation_defect: not supported over this window — the solver integrates to the requested endTime without divergence

reviewer_caveats: min/max(T) values are the last sampled line of the log, not a history, and cannot bound the field over the run
'time step continuity errors' is the solver's own term and is recorded as such, not read as a convergence proof
200 steps at deltaT 1e-5 to endTime 0.002 is a short window; it establishes that the equations can be exercised, not that the case is physically correct
the 0.06 K agreement is a single sampled comparison against one baseline run, not a statistic
